validation: Final native87 binary and unmodified fixed reference, real default/scoped cases compare all mapped fields and multiplicities. Historical cases not rerun retain their own per-case versions. Empty agreement is not positive evidence; no complete plugin contract is claimed.

Raw GUI records can include retained or reused object bytes; matching the reference does not validate every object as active.
Shared pool-carving changes have synthetic padding coverage and real GUI regression coverage; full canonical PoolScanner parity remains unverified.

header_boundary_vectors.scope: Actual PoolHeaderScanner plus actual pre-Vista/Vista pool predicates. Synthetic independent scalar reads isolate tag-only slices, partially external headers, unreadable unused tails and necessary fields. Native tests use real physical/virtual page tables and missing backing segments; these vectors do not prove layer scan chunking or tag discovery across slice boundaries.
header_boundary_vectors.implementation: BlockSize and PoolType are independently read from the scan slice when fully present, otherwise from the matching layer at the exact field address. Header prefix/unused tail do not need to be in the scan slice.
header_boundary_vectors.remaining: Does not prove discovery of tags split across ranges/chunks, scan overlap equivalence, all header layouts or damaged-page and resource-limit contracts.

chunk_vectors.scope: Actual DataLayerInterface/TranslationLayerInterface scan iterators and actual _scan_chunk/MultiStringScanner. Synthetic mapping ranges and read-fault adapter isolate chunk plans, overlap output suppression, data-layer tail repeats and continuation after failed chunks. Does not prove mapping enumeration, crash/hibernation decompression or full pool object carving.
chunk_vectors.implementation: 16 MiB chunk plus 4 KiB overlap, emit only tag starts below 16 MiB per chunk; actual data-layer versus translation-layer tail step; default physical maximum address excluded
chunk_vectors.remaining: Mapping enumeration, all backing formats, tags split across distinct mapping ranges, damaged-page/fault diagnostics and full plugin coverage remain unverified.

mapping_vectors.scope: Actual WindowsIntel/WindowsIntelPAE/WindowsIntel32e mapping and translation over full synthetic page-table bytes. Physical BufferDataLayer subclass models explicit backing holes. Full default virtual range length excludes maximum_address. Covers contiguous/discontiguous PFNs, missing tables and backing tails, uniform tables, transition/prototype flags, uppermost page, large pages/PAT and PAE root/physical-bit limits. Does not certify container mapping/decompression, arbitrary malformed reserved PFNs, all architectures or complete scan fault reporting.
mapping_vectors.implementation: Compare all virtual range starts, lengths and physical starts; backing holes rejected before coalescing, native-domain maximum-address clipping, full PAE root table validation, level-specific large pages and PAE physical mask
mapping_vectors.remaining: All container mapping/decompression, arbitrary reserved PFNs, custom transition layouts, table resource/cancellation limits and full scan fault reporting remain unverified.
